title: Focus-safe overlay key recipes (run FIRST; writes ui/recipes.json)
measures: Index-to-label map of the overlay button row, which key reaches bar focus (scrub label shown, no seek), the CC / Stats / Key plays button paths, and E drift over all presses
needs: YTTV playing on the hidden stick (best during an NBA game so Stats/Key plays buttons show)
pass_rule: |E1-E0| <= 0.5 s (no seek/pause) AND >= 4 row labels AND scrub_focus found
notes: prerequisite for ui_02/03/06/07/08

title: In-player Stats/Scores panel: score changes vs ESPN summary walls
measures: D = first frame showing a new score - wall of the feed play that made it; whether the panel follows the playhead or real time
needs: Live NBA game on YTTV with a Stats/Scores button; --game; network to the ESPN summary API
pass_rule: >= 4 score samples with MAD <= 1.0 s (reports 'realtime' if median < 8 s)
notes: direct real-world D if the panel follows the playhead

title: D from pod edges vs NBA timeout/restart walls
measures: D_start = pod_start - timeout_wall, D_end = pod_end - restart_wall per break; lead pad = D_start - D_end
needs: Live NBA game on a YTTV channel with in-game DAI; today's plays.jsonl being written by the app
pass_rule: >=3 matched breaks in one stick/channel with sd(D_start) or sd(D_end) <= 2 s
notes: live: all ads tests share one read-only capture (ads/ads_run_all.py). --game optional (auto-matched from title)

title: D from YTTV DAI ad-pod bursts vs real stoppage restarts
measures: Pod end on the stick (boot + updated) minus the real restart (D_raw_end); D_est = D_raw_end + lead prior (10 +- 6)
needs: YTTV on an NBA game during TV timeouts, with --game set. Polls media_session every 1 s
pass_rule: >= 3 pods per stick/channel, MAD(D_raw_end) <= 3 s, median D_est within 29 +- 16
notes: independent cross-check of ads_02 using the NBA truth line

title: Key Plays entries: seek target via E_live -> D_raw per play
measures: t_k = E_live + position after seeking to each Key Play; D_raw = t_k - matched play wall
needs: Live NBA game on YTTV with a Key plays list; --game; app recording today's plays.jsonl
pass_rule: >= 3 entries matched and max-min D_raw <= 2.0 s
notes: seeks: test re-links to live at the end

title: Program-title flip vs EPG :00/:30 boundary (t_flip = boot + updated)
measures: D_flip = t_flip - boundary (playhead delay vs YTTV EPG clock) and C_flip = boundary - position per channel+stick
needs: Sticks on YTTV across :00/:30 boundaries (7:00, 7:30, 8:00 PM ...); --minutes must span one
pass_rule: >= 3 grid flips within +-1.0 s of their median and >= 60% of that channel's grid flips
notes: D_flip is vs the EPG clock, not the real event: needs one real-world anchor (ads_02/ui_07) to convert

title: Zero-key D monitor: D_epg = E - C (C from flips/label)
measures: D_epg(t) every --poll s from media_session alone; re-anchors C at title flips; optional D_real = D_epg + --upstream
needs: YTTV playing; a C from ui_05 or ui_02 results (results/ui_05_title_flip_epg.jsonl) or --C
pass_rule: >= 10 min uninterrupted play with sd(D_epg) <= 0.3 s and re-anchors agreeing within 1 s
notes: dry run gives D_epg 18.13 s sd 0.02 over 2,599 rows but verdict N/A (live-only rule)

title: Scrub-bar MM:SS label + program start -> D_ui and C
measures: D_ui = capture_wall - (prog_start + label); C = prog_start + label - media position; knob-pixel cross-check
needs: Hidden stick on YTTV --channel (it re-tunes itself)
pass_rule: >= 5 reads, sd(C) <= 1.0 s across >= 2 tunes, |D_label - D_knob| <= 3 s on every read

title: Decoder-bitrate lag scan vs real break starts
measures: Scans D=0..90 s for the shift that maximises mean |log-bitrate step| at real break starts
needs: Live NBA game, >=4 breaks while the stick shows it (~45+ min)
pass_rule: >=4 breaks, peak contrast >= 1.5 vs best outside +-6 s, and D_peak within 2 s of ads_02/app D
notes: needs --minutes 45+

title: Landing position L repeatability per stick/channel
measures: L = position at first PLAYING update after deep link (alt->channel, x--n), play_s, E_land
needs: YTTV live channel on the hidden stick (any time; no game required)
pass_rule: n>=5 per (stick,channel) and robust sd(L) <= 0.5 s
notes: proves one calibration per channel survives re-tunes; can run pre-game

title: Quarter-end / halftime anchors (pod start + bitrate step)
measures: D at each period end / halftime from the pod start and the largest decoder-bitrate step in wall+5..90 s
needs: Run across end of Q1/Q2/Q3 (e.g. --minutes 30 starting late Q2)
pass_rule: >=2 period anchors with an edge, D values agree within 2 s and lie in 5..90 s

title: Knob pixel on the progress bar -> playhead wall clock
measures: D_knob, C_knob and knob velocity vs expected px/s (about 1.04 s/px for a 30-min program)
needs: YTTV playing; hidden stick for active mode
pass_rule: >= 6 frames, sd(C_knob) <= 1.5 s, median |velocity ratio - 1| <= 0.15

title: Re-link-to-live precision (same-channel deep link after pause/rewind)
measures: cases B (at live), C (paused), D (paused+played), E (rewound): L - L_ref and relink time
needs: hidden stick on YTTV live
pass_rule: C/D/E: p90 |L - L_ref| <= 0.3 s and p90 relink <= 4 s over >=3 rounds
notes: dry run FAILs on recordings (few relinks)

title: Cross-stick pod alignment (D_181 - D_150)
measures: delta = same spot boundary wall on .181 minus .150 per tune pair; dE to test whether position is shared. --tune-hidden tunes only the hidden stick
needs: Both sticks on the same YTTV channel (or --tune-hidden at a dead ball)
pass_rule: some tune pair has >=3 boundaries agreeing (sd <= 0.5 s) and no 10/15/30 s alias scoring >= 80% of the best
notes: read-only unless --tune-hidden

title: Cross-stick content offset on the same channel (matched DAI update epochs)
measures: hidden tuned to visible's channel (visible read-only); 1 Hz both sticks; offset from matched update epochs
needs: visible stick on a YTTV channel with a deep-link code; ad breaks help
pass_rule: >=3 matched events covering >=50% of the smaller train, sd <= 0.3 s

title: Real wall times of timeouts, period ends and restarts
measures: Per timeout and period end: real call wall, back-projected restart wall, duration, certification
needs: Live NBA game (--game). HTTP only.
pass_rule: >= 90% of timeouts have a certified restart and >= 90% of durations fall in 60-240 s

title: Feed first-seen lags and truth availability
measures: Per source first-seen lag; seconds until wall(clock) is certified
needs: Live NBA game (--game; polls pbp every 3 s). HTTP only.
pass_rule: nba_cdn first-seen p50 <= 15 s and truth availability p90 <= 60 s

title: DAI pod cadence detector (media_session 'updated' bursts)
measures: Ad-pod start/spot-boundary wall times (boot+updated), spot-gap histogram, whether pods occur inside live NBA games
needs: YTTV playing an NBA game for 20+ min spanning >=1 timeout
pass_rule: >=80% of in-pod gaps on the 10/15/30 s grid (+-1 s) AND >=1 pod inside a live game window; else verdict no_in_game_dai
notes: answers the gating question for ads_02..12: is there in-game DAI at all?

title: Stick-side break length vs real break length vs NBA rules
measures: stick_len (pod) - real_len (timeout->restart) per break, plus the real break-length distribution
needs: Live NBA game with in-game pods
pass_rule: >=3 matched breaks, median |stick_len - real_len| <= 5 s and MAD <= 2 s

title: VPUD resolution-change events as splice markers
measures: Each 'VPUD Resolution Changed' event classified as tune ramp / DAI pod boundary / real break edge (+D) / other
needs: Live game on the stick for 20+ min
pass_rule: >=3 non-tune events, >=60% of them pod or break, break D values within 2 s of each other

title: Regression over many breaks: D per tune + edge-kind bias, forward-chained by night
measures: obs = D_tune + bias_kind; residuals; forward-chaining CV by night
needs: A full game of captures (ads_run_all)
pass_rule: >=6 observations in multi-obs tunes, mean |residual| <= 1.5 s, worst fold mean |err| <= 2 s

title: E invariance through ad pods (does D survive a break?)
measures: E = wall - position at every pod boundary and first post-pod update vs pre-pod E
needs: Any YTTV channel with DAI pods (studio shows work)
pass_rule: >=95% of boundaries within 0.3 s of pre-pod E and no post-pod jump > 0.5 s

title: Pod-end (return to game) prediction from the spot grid
measures: Predicted pod end (last boundary + median spot) vs first update after the pod
needs: Channel with DAI pods, 20+ min
pass_rule: >=3 pods with an observed return and median |err| <= 2 s, or a stable return lag (MAD <= 1 s)

title: whad-MediaSession event clock (epoch - updated == boot)
measures: Spread of (logcat epoch - updated/1000) across whad lines vs /proc/uptime boot; spot boundaries the poll missed
needs: YTTV playing anything with state changes
pass_rule: boot MAD <= 0.02 s and |median - uptime boot| <= 0.15 s on each stick
notes: dry run PASS is tautological (boot_ref = whad median); live compares with /proc/uptime

title: Logcat tag enrichment around ad splices
measures: Per-tag hit rate within +-10 s of splices vs baseline; top message stems
needs: Live game with breaks, 20+ min (streams all-tag logcat)
pass_rule: a non-whad tag with >=5 near hits and enrichment >= 3x

title: Push-based PlaybackState stream via `cmd media_session monitor`
measures: every pushed update: E = boot+updated/1000 - position, arrival lag, update cadence, actions bitmask
needs: YTTV playing on either/both sticks; best during ad breaks
pass_rule: >=1 run with >=3 updates, sd(E_upd) <= 0.05 s, p90 arrival lag <= 0.5 s

title: Pause d seconds -> dE and auto-rejoin threshold
measures: for d in 2..60 s: dE vs d_actual, residual, rejoined, auto_resumed
needs: hidden stick on YTTV live
pass_rule: p90 |dE - d| <= 0.5 s on >=5 non-rejoin trials; report smallest rejoin d

title: Progress-bar shade segment between knob and live edge
measures: Run-length colour map of the bar row after 0/20/60 s pauses; segment length * s_per_px vs true behind
needs: Hidden stick on YTTV
pass_rule: behind >= 20: segment with |len*s_per_px - behind| <= 2 s; behind 0: segment <= 2 px

title: LIVE badge colour as an at-live-edge detector
measures: Badge dominant colour at the live edge vs after a --pause s pause
needs: Hidden stick on YTTV
pass_rule: Colour A != colour B in every rep, consistent across reps, behind >= 10 s

title: Closed captions OCR matched to plays (surnames/keywords)
measures: D_raw = caption first-seen wall - play wall; D = median - cc_lag; whether captions render in the UI layer
needs: Live NBA game; --game; --enable-cc (in live_args) toggles CC on the hidden stick
pass_rule: >= 8 matched lines and MAD(D_raw) <= 2.0 s
notes: earlier captures (cc_3.png) showed no caption text in the UI layer: low prior

title: Overlay text without pixels (uiautomator / media_session / window / activity)
measures: Byte counts, time-like strings, LIVE and title hits from each non-pixel text source; skips uiautomator on the visible stick
needs: YTTV playing on the stick
pass_rule: Program start/end or playhead time readable as text in >= 2 of 3 reads

title: Tune latency distribution (poll, stick updated stamp, codec log)
measures: play_s_poll, play_s_upd, codec_s per tune across channels
needs: hidden stick on YTTV
pass_rule: n>=8, p90(play_s_upd) <= 4.5 s, median |poll-upd| <= 0.6 s

title: Seek input step size and settle time (keycodes 89/90/21/22)
measures: per press: step, dE, settle_s, state; re-link to live after each variant
needs: hidden stick on YTTV live
pass_rule: some variant: n>=3 non-zero steps, sd <= 0.3 s, settle p50 <= 3 s

title: DVR window length vs L (13 h hypothesis) and live-edge hold-back
measures: rewind presses until position stops falling; reach, min position, step; hold-back L-46800
needs: hidden stick on YTTV live, ~10 min
pass_rule: dry: hold-back stable (sd <= 0.5 s); live: bottoms out within 30 s of position 0

title: Wi-Fi RSSI / stalls vs E steps
measures: E every 2 s + RSSI every 10 s on both sticks; classify each E step >0.2 s; corr(RSSI,|dE|)
needs: YTTV playing on both sticks, 30 min
pass_rule: >=90% of E steps explained by a stall/pause in the same interval

title: Overlay OCR: LIVE badge, scrub label, program slot, delay-setting search
measures: screencap+OCR paired with pos_now/E; with --nav (hidden only) DPAD_DOWN captures
needs: YTTV on screen of the target stick
pass_rule: >=1 OCR-ok capture with LIVE badge or time label; delay_setting_found reported
notes: read-only by default; --nav presses keys (hidden only)

title: Stick clock offset, boot-epoch stability, adb RTT
measures: date+uptime via adb every 5 s on both sticks: offset_s, boot_epoch sd/drift, rtt
needs: sticks reachable over adb (any time)
pass_rule: |offset| <= 0.1 s, sd(boot) <= 0.03 s (or drift <= 0.05 s/h over >=10 min), p90 rtt <= 0.3 s
notes: prep step. 30 s smoke run 03:35: offset .150 p50 0.10 s (FAIL by 0.005), .181 0.05 s; drift rule needs >= 10 min

title: Stick clock offset and boot epoch (stick time to real time)
measures: Live: RTT-bracketed date and /proc/uptime every 30 s, refreshes truth/cache/boots_live.json
needs: Either stick reachable over adb
pass_rule: Live: abs offset p90 <= 0.2 s and boot drift <= 0.1 s. Dry: |p10 estimate - live| <= 0.5 s per stick-day
notes: prep step. Fixed a live-mode crash (name clash). Dry 2026-11-04 PASS (0.17, 0.42 s); the 0.503 s FAIL stick-day is 2026-11-05

title: Fetch and cache the truth feeds, map ESPN ids to NBA ids, build the truth line
measures: NBA liveData pbp actions, share with clock and timeActual, running pairs per period, truth lag
needs: Live NBA games. HTTP only.
pass_rule: >= 90% of games load, each >= 95% actions usable and >= 5 running pairs per period
notes: prep step

title: NBA game-clock rigidity between feed actions
measures: Residual of wall gap minus clock gap for consecutive pbp actions; feed_sigma -> cache/calib.json
needs: --game; HTTP only
pass_rule: ran_frac >= 0.80, p90 abs residual <= 1.0 s, no game below 0.70
notes: best run after the game

title: ESPN wallclock rigidity per league (fallback truth for NCAA and others)
measures: ESPN summary wallclock vs clock residuals per league; flags synthetic wallclocks
needs: --game, --league. HTTP only.
pass_rule: Each league with a real wallclock: ran_frac >= 0.70 and p90 abs residual <= 2.0 s
notes: NHL wallclock is synthetic (N/A)

title: ESPN vs nba_cdn per-play wall-time agreement
measures: ESPN wall minus NBA timeActual for matched plays: match rate, abs percentiles, bias
needs: --game; HTTP only
pass_rule: Match >= 60%, median abs <= 1.0, p90 <= 2.0, abs bias <= 1.0

title: Held-out prediction of play wall times from the truth line (forward-chained by game)
measures: Leave one action out, predict its timeActual from (period, clock); p50/p90 per fold, error-bar coverage
needs: --game (scored at the end)
pass_rule: mean-over-folds p50 <= 0.6 s, worst-fold p90 <= 1.5 s, coverage >= 0.85

title: Tool: YTTV observation (stick time + on-screen clock) -> D with an error bar
measures: D = frame wall minus truth wall(period, clock) with err; --obs-file batch; frozen clocks -> interval
needs: clock readings from another family (results/obs.jsonl)
pass_rule: Dry synthetic (D_true 29): >= 90% within 1 s and coverage >= 0.85. Live: reports D only
notes: post step: run_all runs it only when results/obs.jsonl exists; nothing writes obs.jsonl automatically yet

title: Edge-offset calibration: one true D per channel, then D from E alone
measures: (A) dE between pure-play events inside a landing. (B) K = D - (E_now - E_land) per D sample
needs: YTTV playing on --stick plus D rows (obs.jsonl)
pass_rule: (A) pure-play abs dE p50 <= 0.3 and p90 <= 1.0 s; (B) sd(K) <= 1.5 s with >= 3 samples over >= 2 tunes
notes: post step, same obs.jsonl rule as truth_08

title: Landing drift over hours and 10 s quantized landing modes
measures: L vs wall time every --interval min over --minutes; slope s/h; mode k in L = 46790 + 10k
needs: hidden stick free for a long run
notes: long (default 240 min): run alone, last

title: Per-(channel, stick) Kalman fusion of all anchor families into D_edge (+ D_now via E track)
measures: D_edge, sd, n, robust NIS, D_now per (channel, stick); dry run adds a labelled synthetic check
needs: anchor rows from other families (results/*.jsonl)
pass_rule: n>=3 real anchors, posterior sd<=1.0 s pass (<=2.0 marginal), NIS<=3
notes: post step

title: Estimator stability: Kalman vs Huber vs IV mean vs median
measures: per group kalman/huber/iv/median, differences, downweighted anchors
needs: anchors from other families
pass_rule: n>=3, |Kalman-Huber|<=1.0 s, |Huber-median|<=2.0 s, both sd<=2.0 s
notes: post step

title: Tune-to-tune consistency: L repeatability and per-session anchor agreement
measures: median L, robust sd, range, non-edge landings, per-session D_edge spread
needs: deep-link tunes happening while it watches
pass_rule: >=3 edge landings, MAD sd(L)<=0.5 s, session D_edge spread<=1.5 s
notes: post step; dry PASS 4/4

title: Cross-stick transfer: is the 10 s ESPN landing difference a real delay or a frame offset?
measures: concurrent-pair dE spread, L per stick, dD_edge from anchors vs 0 and vs L2-L1
needs: anchors on BOTH sticks for the same channel
pass_rule: one hypothesis consistent within 1.5 s and the other rejected (>2 sigma)
notes: post step; fixed an empty-median crash on bimodal landings

title: Anchor-family agreement and implied bias of the weaker family
measures: per-family Huber D_edge, pairwise diff and z
needs: >=2 anchor families with >=2 anchors each on the same (channel, stick)
pass_rule: every family pair: |diff|<=2.0 s and |z|<=2
notes: post step

title: Forward-chaining held-out prediction score
measures: MAE/within-2s on held-out anchors, coverage, per-night fold MAE mean and worst
needs: >=3 anchors per (channel, stick), ideally 2+ nights
pass_rule: >=3 predictions, MAE<=1.5 s, >=90% within 2 s, cover2>=0.9, worst fold<=2.0 s
notes: post step

title: Shadow join scorer: predict on-screen restarts and simulate a dead-ball join policy
measures: restart prediction error; joins/skips/mid-play joins on real dead-ball windows vs app-prior-only policy
needs: observed screen events from other families
pass_rule: |err|<=2 s for >=90% of >=3 events AND 0 mid-play joins
notes: post step

title: E-track invariance: E constant while playing, pause additivity, rejoin detection
measures: per-session E jitter, p95 max deviation, burst jitter, unexplained steps per hour
needs: nothing live required
pass_rule: median jitter<=0.2 s, p95 max|dE|<=0.5 s, burst jitter<=0.3 s, <=0.5 unexplained steps/h
notes: post step; dry PASS

title: Audit the app's YTTV sync filter (data/sync.jsonl) against the fused estimate
measures: app mu/sd/synced fraction per channel vs fusion D_now per stick
needs: app running (sync.jsonl) plus fusion anchors
pass_rule: app synced with sd<=2 and |diff|<=2 s, OR fusion sd<=1 s
notes: post step

title: Anchors needed per family for sd<=1 s
measures: stated sd vs empirical scatter, calibration ratio, n_needed, bootstrap sd
needs: >=3 anchors per family
pass_rule: some family or the fused set has n>=n_needed(1 s), calib<=1.5, bootstrap sd<=1.0 s
notes: post step

title: Estimator Monte Carlo self-test
measures: bias, RMSE Kalman vs IV, coverage, propagation error over 300 seeded trials
needs: nothing
pass_rule: |bias|<=0.2 s, cover1 0.6-0.8, cover2>=0.9, RMSE_kalman<=RMSE_iv, propagation err<1e-6
notes: post step; PASS

title: Report: one table per channel/stick (D, sd, n, families, goal grade) + last verdict of every result file
measures: fused D_edge/sd/n/D_now per (channel, stick), per-family estimates, verdict of every results/*.jsonl; writes .jsonl and .md
needs: run last
pass_rule: per row: sd<=1.0 PASS, <=2.0 MARGINAL, else FAIL, n<3 INSUFFICIENT; exits 0 whenever results dir is readable
notes: run_all calls it last

title: YTTV web player reference clock: getMediaReferenceTime() in a muted Mac Chrome tab (overseer 7:35 AM Nov 5)
measures: lag = wall - mediaReferenceTime every 1 s at the live head, plus program-boundary title flips with their ingest epoch (web_flip rows for fusion_13)
needs: Chrome on the Mac with tv.youtube.com open, muted, on the --channel being tested; Chrome 'Allow JavaScript from Apple Events' ON (ask Nick; the test never changes it)
pass_rule: >= 60 live-head samples and lag MAD <= 0.25 s
notes: no picture capture, no DRM; never navigates, mutes or changes the tab. Run it for the whole night alongside ui_05 so boundaries match.

title: YTTV TV app 'Stats for nerds' overlay on the hidden stick: live latency / ingest time?
measures: Broadcast delay value of this stick (read only, from the ⋮ menu tile), then OCR of the Stats for nerds overlay every 1 s (latency, buffer health, any epoch/clock) with the stick's E beside each frame
needs: YTTV playing on the hidden stick; auto-switching paused or --allow-app-active
pass_rule: overlay opens and >= 10 frames carry a latency or ingest number (informational: reports shows_latency / shows_ingest)
notes: Menu (overseer 8:10 AM): ⋮ -> Audio options | Auto-pause | Broadcast delay | Send feedback | Stats for nerds. Never LEFT/RIGHT on the scrubber (it seeks): DOWN until focus is on a known button. Picks Nick on 'Who's watching?'. Never touches Broadcast delay. Turns Stats for nerds back off, BACK x3, re-tune. Run once per stick (hidden each time) to read both sticks' Broadcast delay.

title: Web vs stick alignment: each stick's offset to the ingest clock from shared program boundaries
measures: O_stick = stick title flip (ui_05) - web ingest epoch at the same boundary (ui_12), per channel and stick; the stick-to-stick gap (Broadcast Delay setting?); ui_13 latency if shown
needs: ui_12 and ui_05 run on the same channel across at least two :00/:30 boundaries
pass_rule: some stick has >= 2 matched boundaries within 1.0 s
notes: files only; measures the ~10 s stick gap but never changes either stick's Broadcast Delay (Nick's call)
